title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.

translated_title: 平衡力迫：无需噪声条件化的自适应视频生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14706v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于扩散和流匹配的标准自回归视频生成算法依赖于刚性训练目标和静态采样计划，限制了推理过程对数据的适应性。我们引入了平衡力迫（EqF），一种无需噪声水平条件化的视频去噪生成模型的简化框架。EqF开创了模块化的训练和推理时设计，用于无噪声条件生成，将学习去噪场与采样解耦。这种灵活性允许推理时算法通过适应样本反馈进行闭环操作，在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上提高了视频质量和一致性。广泛的分析精确揭示了移除噪声水平条件化如何使EqF的数据依赖推理特性超越标准噪声水平条件化去噪视频方法的性能。
tldr: 本文提出平衡力迫（EqF）框架，通过去除噪声水平条件化并解耦去噪与采样，实现了自适应闭环推理，显著提升了自回归视频生成的质量和一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a framework that removes noise conditioning and decouples denoising from sampling, enabling adaptive closed-loop inference that improves video quality and consistency in autoregressive generation.
